description: This Java interface defines an abstraction for permission enforcement algorithms within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides methods for checking permissions, retrieving subjects with certain permissions, and building permission-appropriate JSON views based on authorization contexts and permissions.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has explicit or implicit 'GRANT' permissions on a resource, considering 'REVOKE's in the hierarchy for specific permissions.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Overloaded method to check permissions based on a Permissions object.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns subject IDs with granted or revoked permissions on a resource, without considering hierarchy. Deprecated in favor of a version accepting a Permissions object.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Returns subjects with granted or revoked permissions on a resource, without hierarchy considerations.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns subject IDs with permissions granted on a resource or its sub-resources in the hierarchy. Deprecated in favor of version accepting Permissions.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Returns subjects with permissions granted on a resource or sub-resources, considering hierarchy.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the authorization context has permissions somewhere in the hierarchy of a resource.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Creates a JSON view of fields enabled by the permissions of the authorization context, optionally allowing specific fields.
